sources.document_title: STUSB4500 standalone USB PD sink controller with short-to-VBUS protections
sources.locator: Section 2, Table 1, QFN pin-function rows; Sections 2.2.1 through 2.2.16
sources.evidence_extract: Current manufacturer-authored DS12499 Rev 8 retained from a reproducible mirror. QFN pins 1..24 and EP are enumerated. CC is Hi-Z in reset; CCDB enables passive dead-battery Rd. DISCH and VBUS_VS_DISCH have distinct sense/discharge roles. VBUS_EN_SNK is active-low open drain; mirror authority cannot close PRIMARY-SPEC trust.

sources.document_title: STUSB4500 standalone USB PD sink controller with short-to-VBUS protections
sources.locator: Section 7.1, Table 20, absolute maximum rating rows VDD, CC/CCDB and high-voltage VBUS pins
sources.evidence_extract: Rev 8 Table 20 states VDD absolute maximum 28 V, CC1/CC2/CC1DB/CC2DB high-voltage absolute maximum 22 V, and VBUS_EN_SNK/VBUS_VS_DISCH/DISCH/POWER_OK2 high-voltage absolute maximum 28 V. Mirror authority cannot close primary-only trust.

sources.locator: Sections 3.22 through 3.25, register tables 0x25 through 0x29; Sections 3.60 through 3.72
sources.evidence_extract: NVM initializes startup registers. Discharge timing defaults are 800 ms to 0 V and 270 ms between contracts; forced discharge control is separate. PDO registers are volatile R/W views initialized by NVM.

sources.document_title: Getting started with the STEVAL-ISC005V1 evaluation board for STUSB4500
sources.locator: Section 1.1, board overview and PDO list; schematic figures
sources.evidence_extract: Autonomous dead-battery reference board presents Rd, requests 5 V, negotiates PDOs, and demonstrates switched/discharged VBUS plus programmer interface.

sources.locator: Cover Description section, lines describing STUSB-NVM.h export and automatic NVM load
sources.evidence_extract: The library loads a GUI-exported STUSB-NVM.h image automatically and supports read/write customization workflows.

sources.locator: Cover title block and Section 7.1 Table 20 rows; direct st.com retrieval attempted for primary-only trust recovery per issue #43
sources.evidence_extract: Primary-trust recovery attempted 2026-08-02 via WebFetch (canonical st.com datasheet PDF path, STUSB4500 product page, st.com flyer PDF: all timed out; a community.st.com forum-attachment mirror redirected to the forum homepage) and re-attempted 2026-08-14 via direct curl (HTTP/2 request to the canonical datasheet PDF failed with a stream INTERNAL_ERROR; HTTP/1.1 retries of the datasheet PDF and the product page timed out after 120 s and 45 s with 0 bytes, while control fetches to assets.nexperia.com and example.com returned HTTP 200, so general egress was up). No bytes were obtained on either date, so primary authority could not be established or compared against the retained archive.org mirror (src-stusb-ds12499/src-stusb-ds12499-ratings); mirror authority and dependent UNSOURCED verdicts remain unchanged.

sources.locator: NETS table row VREG_2V7 (U1.23, C30.2, R15.2, R16.2, J3.3) and rows SCL/SDA (R15.1/R16.1); pin-map function 'VREG_2V7 regulator decoupling' for U1 pin 23
sources.evidence_extract: VREG_2V7 net bridges U1.23 to C30.2, R15.2, R16.2 and debug pogo pad J3.3. R15/R16 are 4.7k I2C pull-ups whose pin-1 side lands on SCL/SDA; their pin-2 side is fed from VREG_2V7 rather than VDD/VSYS. J3 is the PogoPad_1x8_Debug header, exposing VREG_2V7 externally at J3.3.

sources.document_title: PESD24VS1UB ESD protection diode in SOD523 package
sources.locator: Section 9, Table 6 characteristic rows; Section 11, Figure 10 package outline
sources.evidence_extract: VRWM 24 V; VBR 26.5 to 27.5 V at 5 mA; VCL max 36 V at 1 A and 70 V at 3 A for 8/20 us; unidirectional SOD523.

sources.locator: Section 2, Part No. System codes 2.1 through 2.5; ratings table row 0603; temperature-coefficient table row 0603
sources.evidence_extract: 0603WAF5101T5E decodes to 0603, WA 0.1 W, F plus/minus 1%, 5101 = 5.1 kOhm and T5E lead-free 5000-piece tape; the 0603 table gives a 75 V maximum-working-voltage cap and 100 ppm/C TCR above 10 Ohm, while actual RCWV is sqrt(P times R).
